business_problem: Providence handles more than 10,000 purchase orders and invoices each day across hundreds of suppliers. Requisitioners' questions about order status, delayed requisitions, and expected delivery generated manual work for the procure-to-pay shared services team and slowed information flow to caregivers and operations teams.
solution_summary: Providence uses Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain and Manufacturing (SCM), with the Purchase Requisition Status Advisor embedded in its procurement user experience. Requisitioners ask conversational questions about order and requisition status and receive current details without opening a service ticket or sending a follow-up email. The advisor brings AI into the existing procurement workflow, providing self-service answers to common "Where is my order?" inquiries and reducing routine status work for the procure-to-pay customer service team. The published story identifies no separate model, data ingestion, storage, integration, or deployment components, so the implementation is limited here to the named Oracle application and embedded advisor. Providence reports faster inquiry responses, self-service resolution of common questions, fewer tickets and follow-ups, and more staff time for supporting caregivers and patients.
